_note: One JSON object per line. A confirmation record has: uncertainty_id (16-hex), decision ('confirmed'|'refuted'), resolution_note, winning_citation, decided_by, decided_ref. At build time build_db.py applies these to framework_projection: confirmed -> needs_confirmation=0 + confidence>=0.9 + status='confirmed'; refuted -> status='refuted' + confidence<=0.3. Lines without an uncertainty_id (like this one) are ignored. No wall-clock timestamps (deterministic, committed).
